title: Too Late To Ignore
pitch: AI is moving too fast to ignore, and too fast to catch up on later. Staying current isn't optional anymore. It's part of the job.

acts.title: The machines get capable
acts.sub: AI now writes most of the code, hands work to other AI, and is learning to act in the physical world.

acts.title: Your customers change
acts.sub: How people find, compare, buy and even befriend is moving into AI.

acts.title: Work gets rewired
acts.sub: New colleagues, new platforms, and a career ladder missing its bottom rungs.

acts.title: Follow the money
acts.sub: Trillions going in, prices moving, business models breaking, and the CFO asking for proof.

acts.title: The limits get physical
acts.sub: Power, permission, memory chips, borders and regulation now decide where AI can scale.

acts.title: Trust is the new frontier
acts.sub: AI fights AI, and expertise reaches places it never reached before.
